title_zh: P0 公开交接桌预可行性包络
title_en: P0 Public Handover Table pre-feasibility envelope
decision_boundary_zh: 本文件只检验参赛者提出的 P0 在参考空间、班次、容量、成本敏感性、维护和撤场上是否自洽。尺寸是概念筛选值，费率是参赛者为比较方案而设的敏感性变量，均不是现场测量、规范签认、市场询价、保险报价、批准预算或实施承诺。正式场地、主体、专业签认、三方报价、保险与预算仍由 p0-delivery-contract.json 的八道门阻断。
decision_boundary_en: This file tests only whether the participant's P0 is internally coherent across reference space, shifts, capacity, cost sensitivity, maintenance and removal. Dimensions are concept-screening values and rates are participant-set sensitivity variables for comparing options. They are not field measurements, code sign-off, market quotations, insurance quotations, an approved budget or an implementation commitment. The eight gates in p0-delivery-contract.json continue to block any real site, actor, professional sign-off, three-quote procurement, insurance or budget claim.

reversible_operating_patch.surface_rule_zh: 只使用既有平整、连续、经授权且不需固定土建的表面；不以铺装、结构或永久管线补齐场地缺陷。
reversible_operating_patch.surface_rule_en: Use only an existing level, continuous and authorised surface that needs no fixed construction; do not solve site defects with new paving, structure or permanent utilities.

reference_spatial_envelope.weather_rule_zh: P0 不含新建雨棚；没有既有遮蔽、低眩光照明和可安全撤场条件时，转入室内备选或不启动。
reference_spatial_envelope.weather_rule_en: P0 includes no new canopy. Without existing shelter, low-glare lighting and safe removal conditions, move to the indoor alternative or do not start.
reference_spatial_envelope.professional_hold_zh: 以上均为概念筛选尺寸，不是无障碍、消防、疏散或结构合规结论；真实场地须逐项实测并由相应专业角色签认。
reference_spatial_envelope.professional_hold_en: All values are concept-screening dimensions, not accessibility, fire, egress or structural compliance conclusions. A real site must be measured item by item and signed off by the relevant professional roles.

capacity_and_queue_screening.stop_rule_zh: 队列超过 6 人、两处开口任一被占、1.8 米环线或两个回转位任一失效，即暂停新任务并关闭智能层；工作人员改用既有人工服务点分流。
capacity_and_queue_screening.stop_rule_en: If the queue exceeds six, either opening is obstructed, or the 1.8 m loop or either turning space fails, pause new tasks and switch off the smart layer; staff divert users to an existing staffed service point.
capacity_and_queue_screening.professional_hold_zh: 15 人是面积筛选上限，11 人是参赛者提出的更保守运营上限；两者都不是法定人数、消防容量或现场观测值。
capacity_and_queue_screening.professional_hold_en: Fifteen is an area-screening ceiling and eleven is the participant's more conservative operating cap. Neither is a statutory occupancy, fire capacity or field observation.

reference_operating_roster.coverage_fte_formula: 3000 staffed seat-hours / 1680 productive hours per FTE-year * 1.2 leave/training factor

role_seats.duty_zh: 说明当前任务、开放项、失败项和人工底盘，不替接入方签收。
role_seats.duty_en: States the current task, open items, failures and human service floor without accepting on behalf of the incoming role.

role_seats.duty_zh: 独立复述路线与风险，明确 ACCEPT 或 REFUSE，并保持无 AI 路线可用。
role_seats.duty_en: Independently reproduces route and risk information, records ACCEPT or REFUSE, and keeps the no-AI route available.

role_seats.duty_zh: 只负责叫停、异议、队列和无障碍底线；不得同时承担当班服务绩效。
role_seats.duty_en: Owns stop, dissent, queue and accessibility floors only and may not simultaneously own shift service performance.

reference_operating_roster.absence_rule_zh: 三个席位任一缺岗即智能层关闭；两席可维持既有人工问路，但不得继续共测、签收或发布绩效。
reference_operating_roster.absence_rule_en: If any of the three seats is absent, the smart layer stays off. Two seats may preserve existing staffed wayfinding but may not continue co-testing, acceptance or performance publication.

included_cost_lines.note_zh: 对应 12 条可移动构件；正式采购仍须三方同口径询价。
included_cost_lines.note_en: Covers the twelve removable component lines; formal procurement still requires three comparable quotations.

included_cost_lines.formula: 780 staffed seat-hours * participant labour sensitivity of CNY 80-160 per hour
included_cost_lines.note_zh: 费率仅用于敏感性检验，不是工资建议、合同费率或已批准人员预算。
included_cost_lines.note_en: The rate tests sensitivity only and is not a wage recommendation, contract rate or approved staffing budget.

included_cost_lines.formula: 64 role-hours * participant professional-rate sensitivity of CNY 300-800 per hour
included_cost_lines.note_zh: 只保留专业工作量的敏感性占位；真实专业范围、资质、工时与费率须另行签认。
included_cost_lines.note_en: A sensitivity placeholder for professional workload only; real scope, qualifications, hours and rates require separate sign-off.

included_cost_lines.formula: 24 sessions * CNY 200-400 fixed compensation + CNY 5,000-20,000 accommodation sensitivity
included_cost_lines.note_zh: 失败、退出或拒绝数据不扣固定补偿；金额须在招募方案与预算批准后确定。
included_cost_lines.note_en: Failure, withdrawal or data refusal may not reduce fixed compensation; amounts are set only after recruitment and budget approval.

included_cost_lines.formula: 13 weeks * participant maintenance sensitivity of CNY 500-1,500 per week
included_cost_lines.note_zh: 覆盖开闭场、清洁、纸本、易损件和故障小修敏感性，不含未查明的市政修复。
included_cost_lines.note_en: Tests opening/closing, cleaning, paper, wear parts and minor-fault sensitivity, excluding unknown utility works.

included_cost_lines.note_zh: 这是参赛者设置的撤场储备规则，不代表保险或正式预备费。
included_cost_lines.note_en: A participant-set removal reserve rule, not insurance or a formal contingency.

excluded_unpriced_external_items: 正式报批、检测与法定专业服务
既有场地缺陷、永久市政或结构工程
真实条件确定后的电力、通信与保安增量
participant_cost_sensitivity_90_day.decision_rule_zh: 范围只用于比较 P0 是否仍属 S 级、哪些变量最敏感。未计外部项任一不为零、三方报价未齐或 90 天持续预算未批准时，formal_budget_cny 继续为 null，不采购、不进场。
participant_cost_sensitivity_90_day.decision_rule_en: The range compares whether P0 remains S-class and which variables dominate. If any excluded external item is non-zero, three quotations are incomplete or the 90-day sustained budget is unapproved, formal_budget_cny remains null and no procurement or site entry occurs.

participant_annual_opex_sensitivity.operating_assumption: 4 public hours/day * 5 days/week * 50 weeks/year * 3 simultaneous role seats

checks_zh: 两处开口与 1.8 米环线无阻挡
停用控件、纸本路线与有人窗口可用
线缆防绊、低眩光照明和回执编号连续
投诉、故障与未决项进入下一班
触觉与高对比图无脱落污损
桌椅、导视、紧固与易损件检查
纸本、合理便利物资与备件补充
成本、队列、故障和投诉复盘
继续、修复或终止的独立记录

restoration_checks_zh: 地面无固定件、胶残留和绊点
排水、通行、触觉路线与消防边界恢复
临时数字记录删除且纸本按批准规则处置
既有人工服务位置、时段与责任继续可见
rollback_and_restoration.failure_rule_zh: 四小时目标未在 D1—30 的授权演练中被真实验证前，不得宣传“可快速撤场”；任一恢复项失败即不开放下一场次。
rollback_and_restoration.failure_rule_en: Do not advertise rapid removal until the four-hour target is field-tested during an authorised D1-30 rehearsal. If any restoration item fails, the next session does not open.

alternative_comparison.name_zh: 既有有人窗口＋纸本，不启动 P0
alternative_comparison.name_en: Existing staffed counter plus paper; do not start P0
alternative_comparison.strength_zh: 不新增构件、不制造现场验证假象，保留同一基础服务。
alternative_comparison.tradeoff_zh: 不能产生 P0 的共测、队列、撤场或智能对照证据。

alternative_comparison.strength_zh: 边界小、当班结束即可移入既有室内储存。
alternative_comparison.tradeoff_zh: 只有一个服务面，双联角色和轮椅回转更易互相干扰，不能承接 24 场共测的高峰。
selection_or_fallback_trigger: authorised patch is smaller than 6m x 6m

alternative_comparison.name_zh: 双面公开交接桌（参考方案）
alternative_comparison.strength_zh: 两面服务、三席独立角色、连续环线和两处开口能在同一平面被看见与复核。
alternative_comparison.tradeoff_zh: 依赖既有遮蔽与 7.2 米控制包络；人员而非设备是主要成本变量。
selection_or_fallback_trigger: 6m x 6m reversible patch and two clear openings are professionally confirmed

alternative_comparison.name_zh: 借用既有室内公共房间
alternative_comparison.strength_zh: 天气、照明、储物和线缆条件较稳定，便于小规模受控共测。
alternative_comparison.tradeoff_zh: 城市可见性和路过可达性较弱；若发生租金或装修即退出 S 级参考。
selection_or_fallback_trigger: outdoor weather or utility review fails
an authorised existing room needs no rent or fit-out

alternative_decision_rule_zh: 备选方案只改变载体和空间包络，不绕过八道门。若没有任何方案能在既有、已授权且无需永久工程的条件下满足基础人工服务、双联角色、连续通行和撤场恢复，正确决定是 ALT-0：不启动 P0。
alternative_decision_rule_en: Alternatives change the carrier and spatial envelope only; none bypasses the eight gates. If no option can preserve staffed basic service, dual-control roles, continuous access and restoration in an existing authorised setting without permanent works, the correct decision is ALT-0: do not start P0.
